name: How to Use Menu Hierarchy with Toast POS: Build Better
snippet: Learn how to use Toast POS’s menu hierarchy to organize your restaurant menus efficiently. Discover best practices for building menus, using modifiers, and optimizing the order process across in-house and online platforms.

name: Your Toast POS menu structure IS your operational foundation
snippet: Your Menu is the top level. Think "Lunch Menu" or "Dinner Menu" or "Weekend Brunch." Your Groups live inside menus. These are your categories — Appetizers, Salads, Entrees, Desserts, Beverages. Your Items live inside groups. These are the actual dishes — Caesar Salad, Margherita Pizza, Tiramisu.

name: Mastering Menu Development with Toast POS: A Comprehensive
snippet: Toast POS organizes menus into a hierarchical structure: Menus: The top-level categories, such as Breakfast, Lunch, or Dinner. Groups: Subcategories within menus, like Appetizers, Main Courses, or Desserts. Items: Individual dishes or drinks listed under groups.

name: Understanding the menu hierarchy - - Platform guide - Toast Tab
snippet: Toast products use a hierarchical structure to organize your menu offerings: Menus are the highest level of the hierarchy and represent top-level categories for the offerings your restaurant serves, for example, Food, Drinks, Lunch, Dinner, Happy Hour, or Bar.
